plan.summary:
Raise the upload retry limit from 3 to 5 attempts.

- `retry.max_attempts` in `config/upload.yaml` changes from `3` to `5`.
- `backoff_ms` stays at `200`.
- A comment-only hunk in the same file is left out as noise.
plan.riskRationale: One config value changes. It allows more retries and so more load on a failing upload target. No code or schema change is in the evidence.
plan.storyArc: One config change. It allows two more upload retry attempts.

topics.title: Allow five upload retry attempts
topics.narrativeBrief: What retry limit does the upload config set now? Show `max_attempts` going from 3 to 5 with `backoff_ms: 200` unchanged. Verify how the code reads `max_attempts` (total attempts or retries after the first try) before the writer states the effect.
